title: Peshwa Wheat IPO Details
intro:
Peshwa Wheat IPO is a book build issue of ₹53.52 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 52.99 lakh shares of ₹53.52 crore.

Peshwa Wheat IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 24, 2026 and will close on Sep 28, 2026. The allotment for the Peshwa Wheat IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 29, 2026. Peshwa Wheat IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 1, 2026.

Peshwa Wheat IPO is set issue price band at ₹95 to ₹101 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,42,400 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,63,600.

Finaax Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Bhansali Value Creations Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Peshwa Wheat IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2023, Peshwa Wheat Ltd is engaged in the processing of wheat-based products such as Atta (wheat flour), Sortex Wheat, Broken Wheat, and other flour products including Gram Flour (Besan) and Maize Flour. The company supplies products mainly in 50 kg and 30 kg packaging. During production, by-products like wheat bran are used for cattle feed, to operate with zero waste and zero discharge.

The company operate a modern, fully integrated flour processing unit located at Indore, Madhya Pradesh, with an installed capacity of 56,100 MTPA. The unit is equipped with advanced cleaning and milling technology to ensure high-quality and hygienic production.

It mainly sell the products in the B2B segment across Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Gujarat. Products are sold through Super Stockists, who supply to wholesalers and retailers. Further, it also sell directly to customers who require bulk quantities, such as restaurants, bakeries, wholesalers, and large buyers. In addition to flour processing, the Company is involved in the trading of vegetables, mainly potatoes and tomatoes, within Madhya Pradesh.
As of March 31, 2026, the company has 24 permanent employees.
strengths: Established Promoters and Skilled Management Team
Strategic Procurement Relationship and strong Supply Chain
Strong focus on Quality and Food Safety Standards and maintaining Hygienic Processing Standards

faqs.question: How to apply in Peshwa Wheat IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Peshwa Wheat IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Peshwa Wheat IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Peshwa Wheat IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Peshwa Wheat IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: Peshwa Wheat IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,42,400 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Peshwa Wheat IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Peshwa Wheat IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Peshwa Wheat IPO will be done on Tuesday, September 29, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Sep 30, 2026 . Check the Peshwa Wheat IPO allotment status .
